title: Fragment: Sanguine Brotherhood
obscured_text: You can make out the word brotherhood, but the rest pulls away like a clot in water.
The stone is warm where the letters cross.
revealed_text: This fragment calls the rite a covenant of mutual witness. The Sanguine Brotherhood is not bloodline in the ordinary sense. It is chosen kinship written through risk.
The mark is affectionate and severe: no one joins a shared vein without accepting what may flow back.
